channel.title: GiveOwl – Black Friday sweepstakes 2026
channel.description: Sweepstakes and giveaways tied to Black Friday (November 27, 2026) and Cyber Monday 2026, from US sponsors. Each one is checked against the sponsor's official rules for eligibility, dates and whether a purchase is needed. Black Friday promotions are often short and close within days, so check the deadline on each card.

item.title: Guitar Center Fender Pre-Black Friday Sweepstakes – Guitar Center
item.description: Prize: Fender prize package: American Ultra II Stratocaster, '65 Twin Reverb amp, Jackson American Series Virtuoso, EVH 5150III amp, pedalboard, power supply, pedals and cables (ARV $10,004.71). Deadline: November 11, 2026. Fill in the entry form at guitarcenter.com/gear-giveaway.gc (or scan the QR code in participating stores). One entry per person/email. No purchase necessary; legal residents of the 50 US states and DC, 18+. Oct 29 – Nov 11, 2026, 11:59 PM ET

item.title: KILLSTAR Black Friday Gift Card Giveaway: win a $1,000 gift card – KILLSTAR (Draco Distribution Ltd)
item.description: Prize: One $1,000 KILLSTAR gift card for one US winner (valid 6 months). Deadline: November 22, 2026. No purchase necessary: submit your email via an official KILLSTAR sign-up form and confirm the subscription in the confirmation email. Optional SMS opt-in gives one bonus entry (max 2 entries). Legal residents of the 50 US states and DC, 18+. Ends 11:59 pm ET on November 22, 2026

item.title: The Forward Bar BFCM Sweepstakes – The Forward Company, Inc.
item.description: Prize: Up to a three-year supply of The Forward Bar protein bars (3 winners: 36, 12 and 6 boxes; total ARV $2,159). Deadline: November 24, 2026. Sign up with your email on The Forward Bar VIP list page; free bonus entry requests on the same page (up to 5). Signing up in Wave 1 (by Nov 1) gives the most entries. 18+, 50 states + DC. Ends Nov 24, 2026

item.title: ElectroGum Early Black Friday Apple Watch Giveaway – ElectroGum LLC
item.description: Prize: 10 winners: Apple Watch each (ARV $399, total $3,990). Deadline: November 27, 2026. Free entry: email contact@electrogum.com with subject "Apple Watch Giveaway Entry", your full name, email and state (a subscription order also gives one entry). 18+, 50 US + DC except Rhode Island. One entry per person

item.title: ACON Black Friday 2026 "Ultimate Backyard Setup" Giveaway – ACON (Distributacon Inc.)
item.description: Prize: ACON X 17ft trampoline + ACON X Soccer Goal Panel + ACON X Basketball Hoop with Back Net (worth $4,707). Deadline: November 30, 2026. Sign up with your email on ACON's US Black Friday page (joins the ACON VIP newsletter). Free. Ends Nov 30, 2026, 1:00 AM EST

item.title: Apollo Scooters Black Friday Weekly Draw (US) – Apollo Imports Inc. (Apollo Scooters)
item.description: Prize: An Apollo Go electric scooter (ARV US$749) for a free-entry winner; one winner per weekly draw, 7 in total. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Free entry: submit the form on the Black Friday early access page (marketing emails optional). One entry for the whole promotion. 18+, US residents excl. New York and Florida. Ends Nov 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET

item.title: Insider One Black Friday Power Combo Giveaway – Insider One
item.description: Prize: Cash to cover a 12-month subscription to the AI/productivity tool combo you pick (total prize pool up to $4,999). Deadline: November 30, 2026. On insiderone.com/bfcm-giveaway pick one "stay sane" tool and one AI tool and submit the entry form; 1 entry per person. 50 US + DC, 18+ (19 AL/NE). Ends Nov 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET

item.title: MOON Black Friday Giveaway – MoonWhite (Global Screen Limited)
item.description: Prize: 11 winners, total ARV $975.95: grand prize "The Full MOON" (12 jars of CollaGum and oral-care set, ARV $428), plus gum and teeth kits. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Use the free entry form once a day (each free entry counts as 10 entries). Orders also add entries, but buying is not required. US 18+

item.title: Dave & Sissy Christmas $30,000 Giveaway 2026 – Dave and Sissy Media LLC
item.description: Prize: $200 Amazon gift card to one subscriber in each morning and evening newsletter (Oct 5 – Dec 3); extra $500 gift card winners from Thanksgiving through Cyber Monday, plus a third $500 email on Black Friday and Cyber Monday. Deadline: December 2, 2026. Sign up for the free newsletter and reply to the welcome email with your first and last name – one entry stays in every remaining drawing; bonus entry emails follow. US excl. NY & FL, 18+

item.title: TruDiagnostic Black Friday Giveaway – TruDiagnostic, Inc.
item.description: Prize: One-year TruAge + TruHealth Membership (ARV $1,999), one winner. Deadline: November 27, 2026. Free entry form at trudiagnostic.com/blackfriday on Black Friday only (Nov 27, 2026, ET); a qualifying purchase also gives an entry. Limit one entry per person. US residents 18+. Drawing on or about Dec 14, 2026

item.title: Seranova Beauty BFCM 2026 Cruise Sweepstakes – Valentine Brands LLC d/b/a Seranova Beauty
item.description: Prize: 2 × Holland America Line e-gift card worth US $2,000 (two winners, total ARV $4,000). Deadline: December 31, 2026. Free entry form (linked in the official rules) once per day, Nov 1 – Dec 31, 2026 ET; an order on seranova.com also counts as that day's entry, never more than 1 entry per person per day. US (50 states + DC) residents 18+. Drawing on or about Jan 7, 2027
